case.message: Compare Apple annual revenue and net income before and after November 10, 2023. Explain whether management outlook passages can actually be tested using the retrieved financial metrics.

data.response:
# Apple Annual Revenue and Net Income Comparison Around November 10, 2023

**Insufficient evidence**

AAPL revenue for the fiscal period ended 2024-09-28 was $391.035 billion [E2276ae4d28](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html), up from $383.285 billion for 2023-09-30 [E37ae894052](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html). AAPL net income for the fiscal period ended 2024-09-28 was $93.736 billion [E9b13f66da6](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html), down from $96.995 billion for 2023-09-30 [Ea4a6198b65](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html). AAPL cash PP&E purchases for the fiscal period ended 2024-09-28 was $9.447 billion [Ef6a185d889](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html), down from $10.959 billion for 2023-09-30 [E7d60a5f85f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html).

## What was knowable then

As of November 10, 2023, Apple's historical reporting included fiscal year 2022 and fiscal year 2023 annual results filed on Form 10-K [Ec44d27d55a](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019322000108/0000320193-22-000108-index.html) [E8e7d42add3](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html). For the fiscal period spanning 2021-09-26 to 2022-09-24, Apple reported revenue of 394,328,000,000 USD and net income of 99,803,000,000 USD [Ec44d27d55a](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019322000108/0000320193-22-000108-index.html) [Eb25c257338](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019322000108/0000320193-22-000108-index.html). For the subsequent fiscal period ending on 2023-09-30, Apple reported revenue of 383,285,000,000 USD and net income of 96,995,000,000 USD [E8e7d42add3](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html) [E3f1051831a](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html).

## What happened later

For the fiscal year ending on 2024-09-28, Apple reported annual revenue of 391,035,000,000 USD, representing an increase compared to the fiscal year ended 2023-09-30 [E37ae894052](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html) [E2276ae4d28](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html). Meanwhile, net income for the 2024 fiscal period was reported at 93,736,000,000 USD, representing a decrease relative to the 96,995,000,000 USD reported for 2023 [Ea4a6198b65](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html) [E9b13f66da6](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html).

## The peer test

Only AAPL was selected. Add a peer company to compare results.

## Cross-examination

Because no matching management claim records were returned within the date-bounded source for Apple, management outlook passages cannot be tested or verified against the retrieved financial metrics [E6821590ed0].

## Limits

- No matching records in the date-bounded source for AAPL claims.
- No peer companies were specified or retrieved to allow a direct peer performance comparison.

sections.title: What was knowable then
sections.text: As of November 10, 2023, Apple's historical reporting included fiscal year 2022 and fiscal year 2023 annual results filed on Form 10-K [Ec44d27d55a] [E8e7d42add3]. For the fiscal period spanning 2021-09-26 to 2022-09-24, Apple reported revenue of 394,328,000,000 USD and net income of 99,803,000,000 USD [Ec44d27d55a] [Eb25c257338]. For the subsequent fiscal period ending on 2023-09-30, Apple reported revenue of 383,285,000,000 USD and net income of 96,995,000,000 USD [E8e7d42add3] [E3f1051831a].

sections.title: What happened later

Meanwhile, net income for the 2024 fiscal period was reported at 93,736,000,000 USD, representing a decrease relative to the 96,995,000,000 USD reported for 2023 [Ea4a6198b65] [E9b13f66da6].
